schema:
CREATE TABLE "Warehouses" ("warehouse_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "reserve_qty" INTEGER, CHECK ("reserve_qty" >= 0));

CREATE TABLE "Parcels" ("parcel_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "warehouse_id" INTEGER, "base_qty" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY ("warehouse_id") REFERENCES "Warehouses" ("warehouse_id"), CHECK ("base_qty" >= 0));
correct_query: SELECT SUM(p.base_qty + COALESCE(w.reserve_qty, 0)) AS total_qty FROM Parcels AS p LEFT JOIN Warehouses AS w ON p.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Wraps derived sum alias in CASE WHEN alias THEN alias END without ELSE, turning 0 into NULL and causing SUM over all-zero rows to return NULL instead of 0
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN combined_qty THEN combined_qty END) AS total_qty FROM (SELECT COALESCE(p.base_qty + w.reserve_qty, p.base_qty) AS combined_qty FROM Parcels AS p LEFT JOIN Warehouses AS w ON p.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id) AS tmp
